in_hebrew.name: Adolphe
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Adolphe הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Adolphe is derived from the Old High German name Adalolf, meaning ‘noble wolf’. The name gained popularity during the Middle Ages due to the influence of the Holy Roman Emperor Otto I, who was named Adalolf. The name has been used by notable figures such as Adolphe Sax, the inventor of the saxophone, and Adolphe Thiers, a French statesman.
